description: This file defines an interface 'HomePageEnablerInterface' within the 'OrangeHRM\Core\HomePage' namespace. The interface declares a single method 'isEnabled' which takes a User object as a parameter and returns a boolean indicating whether the homepage features are enabled for that user.

classes.name: HomePageEnablerInterface
classes.description: An interface that provides a contract for enabling or disabling the homepage features based on user properties.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the homepage features should be enabled for a given user.
